scripts.dev:backend: node scripts/init-env.mjs && docker compose --profile dev up -d --build --wait --remove-orphans
scripts.dev:backend:test: node scripts/init-env.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml --profile dev up -d --build --wait
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T db psql -U postgres -d app -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < db/seed.sql
scripts.db:reset: docker compose --profile dev down -v && pnpm dev:backend && pnpm db:seed
scripts.test:api: vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.ts apps/api/tests/upload apps/api/tests/imports apps/api/tests/photos apps/api/tests/substitutions apps/api/tests/household apps/api/tests/sharing
